articles.title: Champion Swimmer Archie Goodburn to Carry the Match Ball Before 60,000 Fans
articles.summary: Scottish swimming champion Archie Goodburn, who returned to racing after brain tumour surgery and now campaigns for research, will deliver the match ball at Scotland's rugby game against Australia.

articles.title: Leon Bridges Reinvents His Sound on 'Happiness Anytime'
articles.summary: Eleven years after his retro-soul debut Coming Home, Leon Bridges returns with Happiness Anytime, mixing in Afrobeats, Brazilian music and disco to get listeners dancing.

articles.title: Fall Back! Daylight Saving Time Ends on November 1
articles.summary: On November 1, 2026, clocks go back an hour as Daylight Saving Time ends - a bonus hour with a surprising history, from wartime fuel-saving to Iowa's 23 different schedules.
